propositions: FixedBench's 35-65% over-action result lacks a plan-review criterion to verify whether a proposed change is actually needed (no criterion examines motivation/reproduction)
Bug tickets currently short-circuit to bare exempt-PASS with zero substantive review (no DET floor, no LLM calls, verified on bug 5886)
A new pass-1 advisory criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that add mechanisms without establishing need, accepting justified no-op/docs-only/well-motivated outcomes
Bug review tier must run the DET floor + necessity probe as advisory (never blocking) instead of full criteria suite, treating bugs as lightweight review cases
Both pieces must register advisory-only (never block) and auto-monitor effectiveness via the standing recorder for potential future promotion to blocking
Acceptance requires non-LLM unit tests for routing/registration/bug-tier lifecycle + bounded live sanity runs (<=8 single-criterion evals) + standing-recorder integration, with no E2 batch dependency
